from google.cloud import translate

def live_caption_translate(text, target_language):
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    parent = client.location_path('your-project-id', 'global')
    response = client.translate_text(parent, text, target_language)
    return response.translations[0].translated_text

from google.cloud import videointelligence

def live_caption_safety(text):
    client = videointelligence.VideoIntelligenceServiceClient()
    features = [videointelligence.Feature.EXPLICIT_CONTENT_DETECTION]
    response = client.annotate_text(text, features=features)
    return response.explicit_annotation

from google.cloud import language

def meeting_summary(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(document)
    return response.document_sentiment.score

from google.cloud import language

def caption_embedding(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_entities(document)
    return response.entities
